subject: Debit note for invoice INV-2526-01280
body:
Dear Nova Systems Pvt Ltd team,

We reviewed invoice INV-2526-01280 dated 8 Sep 2025 and found an error.
The party is in another state (state code 27), so IGST applies, but the invoice charges CGST plus SGST.
We are issuing a debit note for Rs 7,843 and will send a corrected invoice.
Please adjust your records.
Regards,
